body: I wrote down the sour smell after the field truck unloaded its rinse barrels. The meat was still cold when the flies vanished and the siren began.
title: Freezer note in a butcher's hand
gloss: A personal trace places field-program residue before a later restriction.
rival_reading: Emergency workers could have encountered the same residue while responding; the personal trace does not by itself prove the field program caused the emergency.

body:
The shopkeeper made me bring the parcel through the back. He said the front counter was closed to anyone who had been beyond the roadblock.

A visitor checked the wrapper but never asked what was inside. He took the slip with the customer name and left the parcel on the table. It began to drip while they argued about which list should keep the name.

I washed the table when they left. The parcel was still there, and I could not decide whether throwing it away counted as a sale.
title: A separate cut of meat
gloss: A scene-specific count or record was controlled while people were still present.
rival_reading: The same trace could follow an investigation of contaminated farm goods or an ordinary emergency response.
